name: IVPN
author: artemisa81
description: Connect, disconnect and pick a server for IVPN from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Toggle the IVPN tunnel, switch servers, and control the firewall.

schema.label: Server list protocol
schema.description: IVPN publishes a separate hostname per protocol, so the picker lists one of them.

schema.label: Pause duration (minutes)
schema.description: How long the pause button suspends the tunnel for.

schema.label: Look up public IP
schema.description: Ask api.ivpn.net for your public address so the map can show your real location and ISP. Off by default: it is the widget's only network request.
